description: A declared width wraps the text of an inline-block, which grows taller.

florui.css: .p { width: 280px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .b { display: inline-block; width: 40px; background-color: #fff2b8; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 2.78% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 46.79% and the box is 44.0px off, so it fails.
